candidate.rationale: Initial untried candidate: only the qualified baseline is captured; proposal/, reports/, and build/ contain no previous measurements or feedback. Keep the baseline physical configuration (utilization 40, density 0.55, abc_area 0, repair_margin 0) and enable both protocol-qualified mechanical RTL actions. The exact signed 18-bit reduction with sign extension may reduce arithmetic cell area and switching, although synthesis may already eliminate some redundant width. Masking multiply inputs except when accepting a request may reduce idle switching, at the cost of gating cells, control loading, and possible added input delay; workload-dependent net energy savings are not assumed. Preserve the baseline physical settings because setup slack is only 0.19292 ns at period 10526 ps; hold slack is 0.114491 ns, with zero max-slew, max-capacitance, and max-fanout violations. Avoid combining these RTL changes with a more aggressive mapping or placement change before measuring their timing impact. Optimize Q = (cell_area_um2 / 161954) * geometric_mean(E_candidate[w] / E_baseline[w]) over DOT64, GEMM8, and CONV3; baseline energies are respectively 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6, and 1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Die area 377672 um2 is context, not the objective. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, per-workload energy_j, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, and physical/postprocessing/total wall costs; retain failed outcomes and the best qualified result. Qualification and Q improvement remain unmeasured for this proposal. Energy comparisons inherit the baseline Liberty-model, zero-delay post-route activity and extracted-SPEF scope, excluding SDF-delay/glitch and silicon-power claims.
